description: April 1, 2026 Chiaradio Appears on The Exchange w/ Erik Mora Podcast Shubuta, MS — Democratic congressional nominee Michael A. Chiaradio recently appeared as a guest on “The Exchange w/ Erik Mora,” a growing podcast platform focused on in-depth conversations about politics, society, and public policy. During the discussion, Chiaradio and host Erik Mora examined the structural challenges within the American political system, the realities of the criminal justice system, and long-term solutions to homelessness across the United States. The conversation focused on the need for independent thinking in politics and a willingness to challenge failed approaches, regardless of party affiliation. Chiaradio emphasized that voters are increasingly frustrated with a system that prioritizes partisan loyalty over results, and that meaningful progress will require leaders who are willing to question both parties and pursue practical, results-driven solutions. The episode reflects Chiaradio’s broader campaign message centered on restoring trust in government, strengthening economic opportunity, and building a more effective and accountable political system. “The Exchange w/ Erik Mora” is hosted by Erik Mora, known for thoughtful and wide-ranging conversations with guests across the political and professional spectrum. You can watch the full episode here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LNzGKChHXvs To support Michael A. Chiaradio’s campaign for Congress, please visit: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael-a-chiaradio
